deny: Bash(op plugin run -- pulumi stack rm *)

hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command'); if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[;&|(])[[:space:]]*([^[:space:];&|()]*/)?git([[:space:]]+(-[Cc][[:space:]]+[^[:space:]]+|--[a-z-]+=[^[:space:]]+))*[[:space:]]+worktree[[:space:]]+add([[:space:]]|$)'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"git worktree add cannot run here: the Claude Code sandbox keeps .git/worktrees read-only even for excluded commands. Use EnterWorktree with name set to the branch (e.g. ABC-1234-feat-example); the WorktreeCreate hook creates it at $HOME/Codespace/<repo>.worktrees/<name>, checking out the branch if it exists or cutting it from origin/HEAD. For a different start point, create the branch first with git branch <name> <start-point>, then EnterWorktree with name set to it."}}'; fi

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command'); if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE '^[[:space:]]*git[[:space:]]+worktree[[:space:]]+prune[[:space:]]*$'; then out=$(git worktree prune 2>&1); rc=$?; if [ $rc -eq 0 ]; then r="stale worktree entries pruned"; [ -n "$out" ] && r="$r -- $out"; else r="prune failed (exit $rc): $out"; fi; printf '%s' "$r" | jq -Rs '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:("Hook-assisted (ran outside sandbox): " + .)}}'; elif printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE '^[[:space:]]*git[[:space:]]+worktree[[:space:]]+remove[[:space:]]+(--force[[:space:]]+|-f[[:space:]]+)?/[^;&|><]+[[:space:]]*$'; then rest=$(printf '%s' "$cmd" | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*git[[:space:]]*worktree[[:space:]]*remove[[:space:]]*//; s/[[:space:]]*$//'); f=""; p=""; for a in $rest; do case "$a" in --force|-f) f="--force";; *) p="$a";; esac; done; out=$(git worktree remove ${f:+$f} "$p" 2>&1); rc=$?; if [ $rc -eq 0 ]; then r="worktree removed"; [ -n "$out" ] && r="$r -- $out"; else r="remove failed (exit $rc): $out"; fi; printf '%s' "$r" | jq -Rs '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:("Hook-assisted (ran outside sandbox): " + .)}}'; fi

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command'); if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[^[:alnum:]_.-])gh[[:space:]]+api([[:space:]]|$)' && ! printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE 'gh[[:space:]]+api[[:space:]]+graphql([[:space:]]|$)' && printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[[:space:]])(-f|-F|--field|--raw-field|--input)([[:space:]]|=)' && ! printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[[:space:]])(-X|--method)([[:space:]]|=)'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"gh api sends POST as soon as a field is added (-f/-F/--field/--raw-field/--input), so this is a mutating write that the approval rules do not gate in implicit form. Re-run with the method explicit: gh api --method POST ... (method flag immediately after api), which is approval-gated; or run it manually outside the agent."}}'; fi

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | awk '{ if (sub(/\\$/, "")) printf "%s ", $0; else print }'); deny() { printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"%s"}}\n' "$1"; exit 0; }; p='(^|[;&|(`])[[:space:]]*(([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*=[^[:space:]]*|env|command|exec|nohup)[[:space:]]+)*(([^[:space:];&|(`]*/)?op([[:space:]]+[^[:space:];&|]+)*[[:space:]]+--[[:space:]]+)?([^[:space:];&|(`]*/)?pulumi'; t='([[:space:];&|)`]|$)'; if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -Eq "$p"'([[:space:]][^;&|]*)?[[:space:]]destroy'"$t"; then deny 'Pulumi destroy is blocked as destructive, in any form. Perform the destroy manually outside the agent.'; fi; if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -Eq "$p"'([[:space:]][^;&|]*)?[[:space:]]stack[[:space:]]+rm'"$t"; then deny 'Pulumi stack rm is blocked as destructive, in any form. Remove the stack manually outside the agent.'; fi; if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -Eq "$p"'[[:space:]]+-[^;&|]*[[:space:]](up|update|cancel|import|refresh|new)'"$t"; then deny 'Pulumi mutation must use canonical pulumi <subcommand> form so the approval rule matches. Change directory first, or move global options after the subcommand.'; fi

in=$(cat); cmd=$(printf '%s' "$in" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); cwd=$(printf '%s' "$in" | jq -r '.cwd // empty'); ask() { printf 'Install gate: %s' "$1" | jq -Rs '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"ask",permissionDecisionReason:.}}'; exit 0; }; pm=$(printf '%s' "$cmd" | sed -nE '1s/^[[:space:]]*(pnpm|npm)[[:space:]]+(install|i|remove|rm|uninstall|un|prune|ci|clean-install|r|unlink)([^a-z-].*)?$/\1 \2/p'); case "$pm" in ''|'pnpm ci'|'pnpm clean-install'|'pnpm r'|'pnpm unlink') exit 0;; esac; case "$cmd" in *confirmModulesPurge*) exit 0;; esac; sub=${pm#* }; if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -q '[;&|<>`$(){}]' || [ "$(printf '%s' "$cmd" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" -ne 0 ]; then ask 'compound or substituted form; run it as one bare command.'; fi; rest=" $(printf '%s' "$cmd" | sed -E 's/^[[:space:]]*[a-z]+[[:space:]]+[a-z-]+//') "; case "$sub" in install|i) if printf '%s' "$rest" | grep -qE '[[:space:]][^-[:space:]]'; then ask "names packages to add, which brings in new code outside the sandbox."; fi;; esac; case "$pm" in 'npm install'|'npm i'|'npm ci'|'npm clean-install') if ! printf '%s' "$rest" | grep -qE '[[:space:]]--ignore-scripts(=true)?[[:space:]]'; then ask 'npm runs every dependency install script outside the sandbox; add --ignore-scripts to skip this prompt.'; fi;; 'pnpm install'|'pnpm i') case "$(jq -r '.packageManager // empty' "${cwd:-.}/package.json" 2>/dev/null)" in pnpm@[1-9].*) ask 'pnpm older than 10 runs every dependency install script outside the sandbox.';; esac;; esac; st=$(git -C "${cwd:-.}" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all -- ':(glob)**/package.json' ':(glob)**/pnpm-lock.yaml' ':(glob)**/package-lock.json' ':(glob)**/npm-shrinkwrap.json' ':(glob)**/pnpm-workspace.yaml' ':(glob)**/.npmrc' ':(glob)**/.pnpmfile.cjs' ':(glob)**/.pnpmfile.mjs' ':(glob)**/patches/**' 2>&1) || ask "cannot confirm install inputs are committed: $st"; if [ -n "$st" ]; then ask "uncommitted changes to install inputs, which run outside the sandbox: $(printf '%s' "$st" | head -5 | tr '\n' ' ')"; fi; printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"allow","permissionDecisionReason":"Install gate: install inputs are committed and the command adds no new code."}}'

p=$(jq -r '.tool_input.path // empty'); if printf '%s' "$p" | grep -qE '^~'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"EnterWorktree needs an absolute path; a ~-prefixed path does not match git worktree list. Re-run with an absolute path like $HOME/Codespace/<repo>.worktrees/<name>."}}'; fi

input=$(cat); name=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.name // empty'); cwd=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.cwd // empty'); case "$name" in ''|-*|*..*|*' '*) echo "WorktreeCreate: invalid worktree name '$name'" >&2; exit 1;; esac; common=$(git -C "$cwd" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir) || { echo "WorktreeCreate: $cwd is not inside a git repository" >&2; exit 1; }; main=$(dirname "$common"); dir="$HOME/Codespace/$(basename "$main").worktrees/$(printf '%s' "$name" | tr '/' '-')"; if [ -e "$dir/.git" ] && [ "$(git -C "$dir" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)" = "$common" ]; then if [ "$(git -C "$dir" symbolic-ref --quiet --short HEAD)" = "$name" ]; then echo "$dir"; exit 0; fi; echo "WorktreeCreate: $dir already exists and is not on branch $name" >&2; exit 1; fi; if git -C "$main" show-ref --verify --quiet "refs/heads/$name"; then git -C "$main" worktree add "$dir" "$name" >&2 || exit 1; else base=$(git -C "$main" symbolic-ref --quiet --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD || echo HEAD); git -C "$main" worktree add -b "$name" "$dir" "$base" >&2 || exit 1; fi; echo "$dir"
